interpretations: Group telescopes with `bandusagepct` > 47.6 by `calibrstatus`; report each group’s average `bandusagepct` and telescope count.
Group telescopes with `bandusagepct` ≥ 47.6 by `calibrstatus`; report each group’s average `bandusagepct` and telescope count.
Report every defined `calibrstatus`, including statuses with no telescopes above 47.6; calculate averages and counts from telescopes above 47.6.
Report every defined `calibrstatus`, including statuses with no telescopes at or above 47.6; calculate averages and counts from telescopes at or above 47.6.
Treat a missing `calibrstatus` as its own group when reporting qualifying telescopes’ average `bandusagepct` and count.
Exclude telescopes with a missing `calibrstatus` when reporting qualifying telescopes’ average `bandusagepct` and count.
queries:
SELECT calibrstatus,
       AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct,
       COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
FROM telescopes
WHERE bandusagepct > 47.6
GROUP BY calibrstatus

SELECT calibrstatus, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
FROM telescopes
WHERE bandusagepct >= 47.6
GROUP BY calibrstatus

SELECT statuses.calibrstatus,
       AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct,
       COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT calibrstatus
      FROM telescopes
      WHERE calibrstatus IS NOT NULL) AS statuses
LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t
  ON t.calibrstatus = statuses.calibrstatus
 AND t.bandusagepct > 47.6
GROUP BY statuses.calibrstatus

WITH statuses AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT calibrstatus
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE calibrstatus IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  s.calibrstatus,
  AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct,
  COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count
FROM statuses AS s
LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t
  ON t.calibrstatus = s.calibrstatus
 AND t.bandusagepct >= 47.6
GROUP BY s.calibrstatus;

SELECT calibrstatus,
       AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct,
       COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
FROM telescopes
GROUP BY calibrstatus

       COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
FROM telescopes
WHERE calibrstatus IS NOT NULL
